note: v3: refinement of the canonical Corva (corva_v2_02). Starts FROM that image (img2img) so the composition stays; strength is how much is repainted (40 steps x strength = steps actually run). The reference painting is a visual prompt via IP-Adapter (scale = how strongly), for its warm light and white terraced temples. corva_v3_07 is img2img with text only, as a control.
